Hold at least two ESG awareness sessions for staff to embed a
culture of sustainability from 2023.
column2:
The Group held at least 3 ESG awareness sessions for staff across all
operating countries, including sessions on the Kenya Green Finance
Taxonomy and the Climate Risk Disclosure Framework. To promote
Group knowledge sharing, key department representatives from
across the Group attended these sessions.
Particularly in Kenya, the Bank held the following ESG awareness
sessions:
• A sustainability refresher training for 97 sustainability
champions within the Bank.
• Solar financing training conducted with Branch and Customer
Experience Staff, registering an attendance of over 430
participants.
• 10 sessions on health, physical and financial wellbeing
conducted with an attendance of over 1,000 staff.
